gloss: person who likes alcohol; fond of drinking

definitions.gloss: person who likes alcohol; fond of drinking
definitions.explanation: Someone who enjoys drinking alcoholic beverages. Can describe either the person or the quality of being fond of alcohol.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒好|さけず}きだ。
{酒好|さけず}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an izakaya with a friend who loves drinking.

examples.japanese: {酒好|さけず}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たまらない→たまらない：03409_tamaranai⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a bar with an irresistible selection for alcohol lovers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (alcohol, sake) and ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (liking, fond of). The ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ becomes {好|ず}き (voiced) in this compound due to rendaku. A casual, everyday word with no negative connotation — it simply means someone enjoys alcohol, unlike {大酒飲|おおざけの}み or ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦{依存症|いぞんしょう}→依存症：17964_izonshou⟧, which imply excess.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒好|さけず}きな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person who likes drinking
- {酒好|さけず}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たまらない→たまらない：03409_tamaranai⟧: irresistible for alcohol lovers
- {酒好|さけず}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: alcohol lovers gather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}ん{兵衛|べえ}: heavy drinker — colloquial and somewhat humorous
- ⟦{左党|さとう}→左党：23468_satou⟧: drinker, sake lover — literary/humorous synonym
- ⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧: person with a sweet tooth — the opposite pairing, preferring sweets over alcohol

RELATED PATTERN:
The ~{好|ず}き pattern is productive: ⟦{甘|あま}い{物|もの}→甘い物：20464_amaimono⟧{好|ず}き (sweet tooth), ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧{好|ず}き (cat lover), ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{好|ず}き (movie lover).
